🐯 She Found a Wild Amur Tiger and Her Cub Starving in a Blizzard Outside Her Cabin in -71°C Siberia 1 An 80-year-old Yakut woman lives alone in a small log cabin in one of the coldest and most remote places on Earth — the frozen wilderness of Yakutia, Siberia, where temperatures plunge to -71°C. One morning, during one of the worst blizzards of the season, she steps outside to collect firewood. As she pauses to catch her breath, she notices something across the clearing — about 60 meters away, pressed against a rock. A mother Amur tiger. And beside her, barely visible through the storm, a tiny cub just a few weeks old. Both are dangerously thin. Both are freezing. The mother is too weak to hunt. The cub can barely stand.#Siberia #Yakutia #AmurTiger #TigerRescue #tigercub
